name: Knee-free roller-flank knuckle: J3 on a GH ray (b3 0), the pin knee deleted (one rigid bracket), rodless drive
lens: round9:simplest-drive (lens 3, weird / low-complexity: drop the largest non-drive complexity item)
family: redundant 4R with a determined spare (cam-slaved knuckle) on a spherical (zero-closure) cuff

mechanism.notes: J1/K/J2/J3 O20 MR117-2RS; J3 axis on a GH ray (b3 0); K slaved (clock-spring cap), never read; lobe ground into hub 2's cap -> bell crank (MR63ZZ pair, pin in link 1b) -> bent long arm (3 mm Ti) -> MR63ZZ roller on an integral O3 stub (head sampled) -> conjugate flank milled into a lateral boss of link 1a (5-axis / wire EDM); member 3 = hub 3's lower plate + E run + the former knee link = ONE rigid 3 mm Ti bracket bolted to the arm pad on BOTTOM (no knee pins, no knee encoders). Moving bodies: L1a, L1b, L2, crank, roller (member 3 is arm-fixed). Joints: J1, K, J2, J3, crank pivot, roller axle, + the spring-cap stop A counted in the K joint. Loops: drive (lobe-crank-flank-K), K dyad stop. Rolling pairs: lobe-follower, roller-flank. Parts: the round-9 merges of roller-longdyad (lug into link 1a, lobe into hub 2's cap, roller pin into the crank) and the knee link merged into the bracket: custom 15 -> 11; bought 15 - 2 iglidur pins = 13.

verdict: Complexity Pareto point, not a lead change (self-measured, NOT verified): frozen exact Bench(110,360) 21.07 (score 92.34) / 1 mm 23.23 / 2 mm 32.25 (the lead 18.91 / 20.00 / 34.03), held out 24.59 (lead 22.67), flood full 21.07 / knn 23.35, at complexity 23.75 (lead 49, roller row 45.25), 0 passive translations, 0 sensed passives. Converged (5914 configs); the spec's design gate failed (fast 2 mm 20.02 > 15, plain 16.70 > 13, hub 3 0.50 < 0.60).
limiter: the J2 fold (86 of 360 frozen, as every knuckle row) and hub 2's crown in scapular-plane abduction 90-165 (9 of 13 metal-lost poses); in-band: hub 3 on a GH ray sits 28.6 deg oblique to the deltoid (0.505 in band, median 13.9 mm). The knee deletion itself is free on the bench (bracket 0.92-1.0 in band, never touches); the cost is losing the b3 tilt (~3.5 fast / ~2.2 frozen points) and a 1.5x larger liner misfit under GH-centre error.
note: Model docs/concepts/models/kneeless-roller-knuckle-3r.py = the round-9 roller wrapper (roller-longdyad-knuckle-3r.py: PA <= 43, roller stub head, 2 mm objective, ws in-band) on the verified roller-flank model, loaded unchanged; b3 0 forced, knee window dropped, former knee link re-sampled at the bracket level (pin stack removed, 3 mm thick), knee-vs-E / pad-vs-E dropped, bracket >= 0.15 mm off hub 3; knee asserted constant (ptp < 0.5 deg, |s| < 0.05 mm) on every config: 0.000 / 0.000 measured. Search: LHS 258 + CMA 2 rounds x 4 farm streams (5656 tries, 2 mm objective). Seed (b3 0, wd 75, wa -9 on the roller best): plain 15.81 / 2 mm 45.89 fast (the horn lug at 1-2 mm on 12 poses). Fast->frozen +4.37 (knee rows +8.4-9.0). Min th margin 5.14 deg. Spec deviations: chain 'free' (bk2 34-48) so the roller dyad is the start; PA_MAX 43 (round 9) cuts the seed flank to dK 49.0 (56.2 at 45).
